Brandubh · Irish Hnefatafl

The Icon Set

Every piece and board mark, traced to clean vector from supplied artwork of traditional Celtic & Norse symbols. Colour is themed at runtime; the geometry is unchanged.

Attackers · 8 marks

Raider marks

Emblems for the raider pieces — chosen in Settings. Brandubh means “black raven”, so The Crow leads; the rest are Celtic knot and spiral wards.

Defenders

King’s guard

The shield knot rides the king’s four warriors; the crown marks the king himself.

Board · 5 wards

Corner wards

Tree-of-Life motifs for the four corner squares. Traced to hold their shape down to the corner-cell size shown beneath each.

Provenance. Each glyph is an automatic raster→vector trace of a supplied reference image of a traditional, public-domain Celtic or Norse symbol. Only colour and size change in use — every icon inherits currentColor, so it re-tints with the board theme. Raider marks live in src/emblems.ts, the king’s shield knot in src/shieldKnot.ts, and the corner wards in src/cornerEmblems.ts.
